report:
## Standards

- **Hard violation — repair artifacts omit the required stable `R1..Rn` ledger.** `.ak/dockets/issues/10/review/final-closure-review/repairs/generic-authorization.md:3` and `.ak/dockets/issues/10/review/final-verification-review/package-prepack-isolation.md:3` place their mandates in prose without stable item identifiers. This violates `docs/development-closure.md` item 7 and `packets/fixer-repair.md`: “No mandated item may arrive only as prose outside this set.” The generic-Authorization apply report and prepack plan report therefore cannot undergo the required exact-key reconciliation.

- **Judgement call — possible Speculative Generality.** `test/helpers/pi-test-harness.ts:108-142` adds and returns `IsolatedPackResult.filename`, but no caller in the target reads it:

  ```ts
  filename: string;
  // …
  filename: entry.filename,
  ```

  The field expands the helper result surface without a demonstrated requirement.

## Spec

- **High — generic Authorization auth-parameter credentials remain partially exposed.** The repair requires “a generic Authorization scheme and its complete credential value [to be] redacted as one boundary,” and Plan-002 §2 requires that “no secret reaches staging [or] final core.” `src/recorder/scanner.ts:34-36` consumes only a token68-like credential after an arbitrary scheme. A temporary detached-worktree probe at the pinned target produced:

  ```text
  Authorization: Digest username="Mufasa", realm="testrealm", nonce="abc123"
  → [REDACTED]"Mufasa", realm="testrealm", nonce="abc123"
  ```

  The probe was scratch evidence and was deleted; the cited scanner regex and admission path are fixed-target facts. Digest/custom schemes with quoted or comma-separated auth parameters retain credential suffixes. External inputs use this scanner and write the resulting bytes to staging (`src/recorder/admit.ts:279-284`), so the suffix remains promotable. The regression at `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts:332-336` covers only `Token` with one token68 value, not generic parameterized credentials.

Summary: Standards — 2 findings; worst is the documented repair-ledger violation. Spec — 1 finding; worst is incomplete generic Authorization redaction allowing credential suffixes into promoted external inputs.
